built.label: the rule -- the currency check, the authority clause
built.text: - **Currency check.** If a reviewer's claim disagrees with the current MANIFEST (version, md5, or last-commit), the MANIFEST wins and the claim is stale — re-derive before acting on it. Rule 5 above applies transitively: the freshest export wins.

built.label: the rule -- the procedure and the manifest columns
built.text: - **Procedure.** Create `D:\MY-DOwnloads\mirror-refresh-<today>\` fresh; copy in flat the reviewer set (FINDINGS, REGISTRY, OPEN_TRAILS, SPIRAL_MAP, VERIFICATION_LOOM, ERRATA; the five RH-rail papers at current version; EXCLUSION_ENGINE, FOUNDATIONS_OF_THE_SIDE_PROGRAMME, ADDITIVE_MULTIPLICATIVE_CONSPIRACY, BALANCE_AND_POSITIVITY, GRH_CASCADE, SILENCE_STAGES_DEALIGNMENT, FORMATION_DISTANCE_AND_SILENCE_AS_PROTECTION, INVARIANCE_BARRIERS [was SIEVE_CEILING_LEMMA]). Write MANIFEST.md (per file: bytes · md5 · version line · last-commit; header pins the source HEAD; a generated export artifact, not a repo file). Zip. The MANIFEST's md5 + last-commit columns are the reviewer's authority — cite from the export, not from recall.
